feeds.title: Paris Perfect Blog
feeds.description: Discover the inside scoop on the latest events in Paris, hottest shopping and dining spots, travel tips, best Paris tour experiences, exclusive offers and latest Paris news from the Paris Perfect team. Our goal is to offer you an extraordinary experience in the most beautiful city in the world by enhancing your vacation and helping you to explore and experience the delights of living in Paris.

feeds.title: Secrets of Paris
feeds.description: Secrets of Paris is the insider's guide to Paris news, events, sightseeing and living in the City of Light. Established in 1999, the Secrets of Paris is one of the oldest independent and locally-owned websites about Paris in English. The Secrets of Paris website and newsletter were created by Heather Stimmler, an American-born journalist living in France since 1995.

feeds.title: HiP Paris
feeds.description: Visiting Paris for the first time? Been here before and want to explore a new part of town? HiP Paris Blog will point you in the right direction and introduce you to off-the-beaten-path places, hip and happening people and events, and experiences you might otherwise overlook.

feeds.title: World In Paris
feeds.description: We're Elisa, Norbert, Valérie, and Cédric, the 4 Paris travel bloggers & friends behind World in Paris. Quirky explorers with a preference for the local side of our city and its lesser-known sights, we are continuously looking for new ideas to enjoy the best of Paris & around. Do you want to go beyond the Louvre Museum or the Eiffel Tower? Read our blog for first-hand information & our best tips to help plan your own adventures in Paris.

feeds.title: Salut from Paris
feeds.description: Tips and Info about Paris that will help you plan your next trip. Find the best places recommended by locals and friends.

feeds.title: Paris Through My Lens
feeds.description: I am a former elementary school teacher, a full-time photographer, lover of all things French, obsessive Paris traveler, enthusiastic church and community volunteer, and grandmother to 5 delightful grandchildren. Blog by Virginia.

feeds.title: Roaming Paris
feeds.description: We are full-time travelers in France with a passion for travel throughout Paris. Through this blog, you can discover Paris travel guides, inspiration, food including what to eat & drink, where to stay, and all other things to do in Paris. We hope to inspire you to travel to Paris while we help you plan your Parisian adventure in style.
